risk_description:
The metal material of the hairpins contains an excessive amount of cadmium (measured value 72% by weight). Cadmium is harmful to human health because it accumulates in the body, can damage the kidneys and bones, and it may cause cancer.
The metal material of hairpins also contain an excessive amount of lead (measured value: 81 % by weight). Lead is harmful to human health, accumulates in the body, can cause developmental neurotoxicity and may also affect breast-fed or unborn children.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the REACH Regulation.
